dashboard.settings.autoAcceptHelp: Orders are confirmed automatically. If the requested slot is full, the order moves to the next free slot. It confirms only when there is capacity. Orders with a customer note (e.g. an allergy) still have to be confirmed by you.
dashboard.settings.layoutHelp: How items appear on the page called “+ Add order”.
dashboard.settings.layoutTabsHelp: Shows one category at a time. Tap a category to switch. Since every item stays in the same place, it suits long menus.
dashboard.settings.layoutScrollHelp: Shows all items in one scrolling list, giving each category a heading. There are no category buttons — you scroll the page to move around. Since most of it can be seen at once, it suits short menus.
dashboard.settings.paidStepHelp: When you add an order yourself, it adds a button saying “Confirm”; with it you can submit the order now and take payment later.
dashboard.settings.takesCashHelp: Splits the payment button into two buttons saying “Cash” and “Card”.
dashboard.settings.orderReadyHelp: Shows a button saying “Mark ready” on the orders page. The kitchen display (KDS) is set up separately. Each time an order is marked ready, customers receive an email.
dashboard.settings.buzzerPromptTitle: Remind me to give a buzzer
dashboard.settings.buzzerPromptHelp: As soon as you submit an order the buzzer grid opens, so the number goes on the board while the customer is still in front of you. When it is off you can still add a buzzer at any time by tapping the order, but no reminder comes. Useful where you hand out buzzers; where you do not, you can easily switch it off.
dashboard.settings.cardsHelp: Turn this off when a card problem happens; customers submit orders as usual but make the payment at the truck. Orders keep coming in; only the card step stops.
dashboard.settings.cardsScope: This applies to your whole food truck on all events, and stays off until you turn it back on.
dashboard.settings.soundsHelp: The on/off switch is on each screen; every device controls its own sound.
